scope: Sample attribution only. Same page and process share heaps/GC; independent package modules with an explicitly allowed native-storage.js difference and identical WASM bytes. Leaf language and role categories are disjoint. Inclusive groups overlap and are not additive; union categories de-duplicate ancestors. HTTP .wasm frames count as WASM even when V8 uses the other package URL for shared compiled code. Rust crate hashes are normalized for symbol grouping; inlining and regex coverage still limit attribution. Samples do not prove allocation counts or call frequency. Profiler throughput is not the latency acceptance benchmark.
